div.head: III Atr 4.1
div.ab: Gif he þonne ful beo, slea man hine, þæt him forberste se swéora; ⁊ gif he þæt ordal forbuge, gilde angylde þam agenan frian ⁊ landrícan XX óran ⁊ gá eft to þam órdale.
Si tunc sit immundus, percutiatur, ut collum ei frangatur; et si uitet ordalium, reddat semel captale suum repetenti et terre domino uiginti oras et eat rursus ad ordalium.
Gif he þonne ful beo, slea man hine, þæt him forberste se swéora; ⁊ gif he þæt ordal forbuge, gilde angylde þam agenan frian ⁊ landrícan XX óran ⁊ gá eft to þam órdale.

Wenn er aber [beim Ordal] schuldig befunden wird, schlage man ihn, dass ihm das Genick bricht; und wenn er den [ersten] Ordal[termin] vermeidet, zahle er [den Sachwerth des Gestohlenen] an dessen Eigenthümer einfach und dem Immunitätsherrn 20 Ör und schreite nachher zum Ordale.

But if he is found guilty [at the ordeal], let him be struck so that his neck breaks; and if he avoids the [first appointed] ordeal, let him pay the owner [the value of the stolen goods] once and the lord of the immunity 20 ores, and go to the ordeal afterwards.

If then he is proved guilty, he shall be struck such a blow as shall break his neck. But if he evades the ordeal, he shall pay the value [of the goods] to their owner, and 20 ores to the lord of the manor, and shall thereafter go to the ordeal.

If then he is convicted, he is to be struck so that his neck is broken; and if he fails to appear at the ordeal, he is to pay the simple value of the stolen goods to the owner and 20 ores to the lord of the estate, and go to the ordeal afterwards.

note.seg: Nur der zum zweitenmal Ordalfällige wird hingerichtet nach I Atr 1, 5.—Cervicem frangere sagt Vulgata I Reg. 4, 18 vom Sturze eines Greises, nicht von einer Hinrichtung
Only the man who fails in the ordeal a second time is executed, according to I Atr 1, 5. — The Vulgate, I Reg. 4, 18, says Cervicem frangere of an old man's fall, not of an execution
Denn es folgt ein zweiter laut nächster Zeile; Verklagter ist hier nicht, wie in 6, 2, gleich entflohen
For a second one follows, according to the next line; the accused has not here, as in 6, 2, fled at once
S. o. 3, 4². Kläger soll, meint Schreuer, nicht durch Versäumnis des Beklagten leiden
See above 3, 4². The plaintiff, Schreuer thinks, is not to suffer through the defendant's default
Strafe für Gerichtsversäumnis (s. d. Gl 3d. f. 13a), die auch den ausbleibenden Kläger laut 4, 2 trifft; über dieses Strafgeldfixum s. d. Gl 22
Penalty for default of court (see that word in Gl 3d. f. 13a), which according to 4, 2 also falls on the plaintiff who fails to appear; on this fixed fine see that word in Gl 22
Unter Bedd. von eft wählt Q falsch: ‘wiederum’
Among the meanings of eft Q chooses wrongly: ‘again’
